title: File a fix-at mistake once across features
action: Implement docs/history/fix-at-loop/CONTEXT.md D1. Anchors: in verbs/drivers/close.rs `fn file_fix_at_rows(root: &Path, feature: &str) -> FixAtRows {` and its call `if backlog::backlog_finding_exists(root, feature, &layer, &title) {`; in verbs/backlog.rs `pub(crate) fn backlog_finding_exists(root: &Path, feature: &str, layer: &str, title: &str) -> bool {`. Add a sibling helper in backlog.rs that, per D10, returns the feature of a finding row with this layer and the same crate::verbs::feedback::normalize_title in the CURRENT close epoch (its ts is newer than the newest backlog-closed row with the same normalized title), or None; call it from file_fix_at_rows in place of the per-feature check. After a close, the same mistake files a new row. A skip still counts in rows.skipped; when the owning feature differs from the closing one, the close line's `bee backlog findings --feature` pointer names the owning feature (anchor: the `(M already there)` line near close.rs:3217). backlog_finding_exists and bee backlog add stay unchanged. Update the doc comments the change makes false only by deleting them; write no new comment. Edit only the existing tests the change forces; the tester cell adds the new ones. Run the related tests and quote the count the filter matched. REWORK after judge NEEDS_REVISION: delete the doc comment above file_fix_at_rows in close.rs that names current_epoch_finding_feature (it was rewritten, the rule is delete only), and delete the now-false doc comment on backlog_finding_exists in backlog.rs; write no new comment; keep #[cfg(test)] on backlog_finding_exists (leader decision 4dadfe44). Re-run cargo clippy -- -D warnings and cargo test --bin bee -- fix_at_identity and quote both.
